q1.sampleAnswer: My name is Li Ming. I’m thirteen years old. I live in Hangzhou, in China. I go to the cinema about once a month, usually at the weekend. I usually watch films with my parents, but sometimes I go with my friends. Last month I watched an animal film about a little panda. It was very funny and the music was great. I liked it a lot. My journey to school takes about twenty minutes. I go by bus, and sometimes my dad drives me. I think the best way to travel around my area is by bike, because it’s cheap and good for you.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法与词汇：简单语法结构的掌握，日常话题词汇的运用
互动交流：回答切题，内容充分，能延展回答
整体表现：能用简单的语言完成交流任务

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答能直接回答每个问题，并多说一两句理由或细节（例如和谁看电影、看过的电影讲什么、怎样上学），用简单而正确的句子连贯表达。

q2.sampleAnswer: I like swimming in a lake because it’s cool in summer, but I don’t like running in a city because there are too many cars. I think swimming in a lake is a good idea if an adult is with you. Climbing a mountain is hard, but it’s exciting. Spending time in a forest is interesting because you can see birds and animals. Having a barbecue at home is great because the whole family can eat together. Running in a city isn’t very healthy, because the air isn’t clean. I like having a barbecue best. I prefer doing activities outdoors when I have free time, because I can play with my friends in the fresh air. The best time for me to do outdoor activities is on Saturday morning, because I don’t have school and it isn’t too hot.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答会对图片中的每种户外活动表明喜欢与否并给出理由，能回答考官的追问（如在湖里游泳、爬山、在城市跑步等），说出最喜欢哪一种，并用 because 等连接词展开。
